The published Players Committee asset is a PNG at a source URL ending in .gif. Its unchanged bytes were uploaded using a .png filename. The public wiki original was downloaded after upload and checked against the source and archived payload: 280483 bytes, SHA-256 <code>28d7c51123bd0edafd82c7f28cff743fa0e9799bcd1dde770277b30dd6d9094f</code>. The File page labels the exact-byte source-host archive separately and preserves the printed image credit. Its source-host content mapping is being reported to the existing image-preservation Story.
